NoHidingFromTheWatchers.description: Any <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> this unit takes is reduced to 0. After being attacked, this unit moves {[nrOfTiles]} hex, trying to move away from all other units. If there is no other friendly <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Dark Angel</style> on the battlefield except other <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Watchers in the Dark</style>, then this unit leaves the battlefield.
